target.statement: K-Means (scikit-learn) final inertia score is non-repeatable across 30 replications when using 4 OpenMP threads on the Iris dataset (bitwise repeatability fails)

compute.basis: Iris is tiny; 30 K-Means runs with n_init=5 at 4 threads take seconds, plus pip install of scikit-learn/numpy and a UCI download; the main cost is writing the harness and comparing JSON outputs.

blockers: The exact non-repeatability depends on OpenMP thread scheduling and CPU architecture; a laptop with 8 cores may not reproduce the same bitwise differences as the paper's 208-thread Xeon, so the qualitative claim (inertia differs across runs) may or may not appear
GitLab repo link may be inaccessible/private; code must be rewritten from the paper's described protocol
title: A K-Means, Ward and DBSCAN repeatability study
